title: Cancel Spotify Premium in India: Steps, Refunds, UPI (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Spotify Premium in India from your account page, learn what happens to Premium and your playlists, check refund rules, and stop a UPI AutoPay mandate.
h1: How do you cancel Spotify Premium in India?
summary: To cancel Spotify Premium in India, open your account page in a browser, select Cancel plan under Your plan or under Manage your plan, and go through the confirmation message. Premium stays active until your next billing date, then the account switches to free and your playlists and saved music stay with you. If a partner such as a mobile or internet provider manages your payments, cancel with that partner, and if you paid through a UPI app, also revoke the AutoPay mandate there.
stepsHeading: How to cancel Spotify Premium in India

steps.name: Open your account page
steps.text: Go to spotify.com in a browser on your computer, phone or tablet and log in with the method you used to sign up, such as email, phone number, Apple, Google or Facebook. Then open your account page. Spotify's help article describes the cancel option on the account page, so use a browser if you cannot find the same label in the app.

steps.name: Select Cancel plan
steps.text: On the account page, select Cancel plan under Your plan at the top of the screen, or under Manage your plan. If you are on a Duo or Family plan and you are the plan manager, this cancels the whole plan. If you are only a member, this removes your account from the plan without cancelling it.

steps.name: Finish the confirmation
steps.text: Continue through to the confirmation message. Your Premium stays active until your next billing date, after which the account switches to free. Take a screenshot of the confirmation screen, because the help article does not describe a separate cancellation email.

steps.name: Check for a partner-billed plan
steps.text: If the page shows no Cancel plan option and no option to change plan, your plan is probably billed by a partner company. Go to Manage your plan, check Payment, and use the contact link shown there to cancel with that company.

steps.name: Revoke the UPI mandate
steps.text: Open the AutoPay section of your UPI app and revoke any Spotify mandate with your UPI PIN. In Google Pay the section is under Autopay, in the Live tab; the label may read AutoPay or Mandates depending on your app version.

sections.heading: What happens to your plan after you cancel
paragraphs: Spotify's help article on billing says each Premium plan is charged once per month. Cancelling stops the next monthly charge. It does not reverse a charge that has already gone through, and Spotify's refund page says you keep what you paid for and remain on Premium until the end of the billing period.

Cancelling during a zero-priced free trial switches the account to free straight away. Zero-priced free trials and legacy Premium Individual, Duo and Family plans cannot be reactivated once cancelled, so if you want Premium back later you will need to sign up on the current plan list.

sections.heading: Refunds and plans bought through a partner
paragraphs: Spotify's refund page says that if you no longer want Premium you can cancel any time and keep what you paid for. It does not promise a refund for days already used in the current month, so if you want money back for a specific charge, contact Spotify support and quote the transaction reference from your receipt. Gift cards bought from a store cannot be refunded by Spotify and should go back to the store.

Payments made through a partner are refunded by that partner. Spotify's help page says to find the partner's details on your account page under Your plan. Google Play billing questions are handled by Google, so for a Play charge use the Google Play refund request option in the Play Store app.

sections.heading: Canceled but still charged
paragraphs: The most common cause is that you are logged in to a different Spotify account from the one you cancelled. Check the email address or phone number on the account page before you try again. Spotify's help article says that if you cancelled just after a payment was processed, you will not be charged again and can carry on with Premium until the date the account switches to free.

A second charge in the same month can happen when a failed payment is retried. The help article says your bank statement may show both the failed attempt and the successful one, and that a pending or processing entry is usually a temporary authorisation from your payment provider. If the plan still shows as active after cancelling, run the cancel steps again and make sure you reach the confirmation message.

sections.heading: Stopping the UPI AutoPay mandate
paragraphs: Spotify's UPI help page says you can pay through a UPI app, by entering a UPI ID, or by scanning a QR code on desktop, and that your UPI provider must support recurring payments through UPI AutoPay. The page does not say how each renewal is collected, so after you cancel, check the AutoPay or Mandates list in every UPI app you have used with Spotify.

In Google Pay, Google's help says you can change or revoke an active mandate from the Live tab under Autopay, and that revoking needs your UPI PIN. After a mandate is revoked, the merchant cannot debit your account under it. Google Pay also sends a notification 24 hours before a debit, and you can pause or cancel from that notification. Cancel the Spotify plan first, then revoke the mandate, so that no payment is left waiting to fail.

sections.heading: Why tracking renewals helps
paragraphs: Spotify renews monthly, so a Premium plan you stopped using can run for months before you notice it. Writing the plan down with its renewal date and monthly cost makes the next debit visible before it happens. Essara works this way: you add each subscription or UPI mandate yourself, set its renewal date and see the monthly and yearly cost in one place. It does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS, so the details are entered by hand.

faqs.q: Can I cancel Spotify Premium from the Android app?
faqs.a: Spotify's help article describes the cancel option on the account page. The help article does not name the in-app menu, so the safest route is to open spotify.com in a browser, log in and cancel there.

faqs.q: Will I get a refund if I cancel Spotify Premium mid-month?
faqs.a: Spotify says you can cancel any time and keep what you paid for, with Premium running until the end of the billing period. The refund page does not promise a refund for unused days, so contact Spotify support if you want money back for a specific charge.

faqs.q: Does Spotify offer a prepaid Premium plan in India?
faqs.a: I could not confirm a prepaid Premium plan for India in Spotify's official help pages. The cancel and billing articles describe monthly charges. Check the plan options at checkout, and if a plan is prepaid, its payment details should say so before you pay.

faqs.q: Does deleting the Spotify app stop my payments?
faqs.a: No. Spotify's help describes cancelling on the account page, so removing the app does not end the plan. Cancel on the account page first, then check that the plan shows as free.

faqs.q: Spotify still debited my UPI account after I cancelled. What now?
faqs.a: Open the AutoPay or Mandates section of your UPI app and revoke the Spotify mandate with your UPI PIN. Then contact Spotify support with the transaction reference, the date of the charge and a screenshot of the cancellation confirmation.

faqs.q: Why is there no cancel option on my Spotify account?
faqs.a: Spotify's help article gives three common reasons. The account may be on free, which means there is no Premium plan to cancel. The plan may be billed by a partner, in which case you cancel with that partner. Or you may be a member of a Duo or Family plan, where only the plan manager can cancel the whole plan.
